rows.label: Pox
rows.note: Ghost tier: 5,000 cr, 20 Mutagen Sample, 200 Plastids, 900 Nano Spores, 250 Rubedo; 3 days

conditions: Research costs scale with clan tier: Ghost x1, Shadow x3, Storm x10, Mountain x30, Moon x100. Every bigger barracks raises the tier.
In an established clan it's usually done already.

groups.activity: buy the Pox and Mutagen Mass blueprints

rows.label: Mutagen Mass Blueprint
rows.alt: skip any you cover with Invasion or Orb Vallis bounty Mass

conditions: Coda Pox is a separate MR 17 weapon from Eleanor and does not substitute here.

rows.label: Mutagen Sample
rows.note: for 4 Mutagen Mass; add 40 more if the clan still needs both researches
rows.alt: Infested Invasions and Orb Vallis Lvl 30-50 bounties pay finished Mutagen Mass

rows.label: Nano Spores
rows.note: comes in thousands from any Deimos run

conditions: Mutagen Sample is the raw resource; Mutagen Mass is the crafted item. Son's "Mutagens" in the Necralisk are a different item and don't count.
Terrorem's Infested get stuck in side rooms; Hyf defense brings enemies to you.
bonuses: Nekros, Khora, Hydroid or Atlas with Ore Gaze multiply Sample drops, though at 40 it's optional.
